topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes for cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: It sets the aims and overview for understanding the hallmarks of cancer and their underlying genetic mechanisms.

topics.label: Deregulation of growth signaling pathways in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic and tumor suppressor mutations alter cell-surface and intracellular signaling cascades to sustain proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Block to terminal cell differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer cells disrupt normal maturation lineages in hematopoietic and epithelial tissues.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: It details how alterations in p53 and Bcl-2 family proteins prevent programmed cell death in cancer cells.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, senescence, and stress responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cells regulate lifespan through telomeres and senescence, how tumors bypass these barriers, and how p53 mediates protective stress responses.

topics.label: Reprogramming of cellular metabolism in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce complex cancer hallmarks and explain how tumor cells alter metabolic pathways, aerobic glycolysis, and Krebs cycle enzymes to support growth.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: It explains the requirement and regulation of new blood vessel formation to supply growing tumors with oxygen and nutrients.

topics.label: Mechanisms, barriers, and genetics of tumor metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the metastatic cascade, the monitoring of circulating tumor cells, factors affecting metastatic efficiency, and genomic features of secondary tumors.

topics.label: Conclusion and summary of cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: It reviews the integration of cancer hallmarks and concludes the lecture.
